title: Suggestion - Disk and Devices on Desktop as icons
line: The desktop can now show connected disks and USB sticks as icons that mount when opened, with a new "Show connected devices" option in its Filter settings.
explanation: Folder View only listed the files of its folder, so connected disks could only be reached through the Device Notifier or a file manager, unlike the old KDE desktop that showed them as icons. The change adds a "Show connected devices" option (off by default) to the Filter page. When it is on, the devices from the Places panel's Devices and Removable Devices groups (minus the ones hidden there) appear as desktop icons that follow plugging, unplugging, mounting and unmounting; opening one mounts it if needed and opens it, its menu offers Open, Mount or Safely Remove/Unmount/Eject and Properties, and files dropped on a mounted one are copied onto it.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: add an option to show connected devices as icons

Folder View had no way to show disks and other devices on the desktop,
as the old KDE desktop did. A new Filter option adds the Places panel's
devices as icons that mount when opened and offer the unmount actions.

BUG: 443701

media.caption: Before: the desktop's Filter settings have no option for devices.
After: new "Show connected devices" option; once applied the plugged-in USB stick shows up on the desktop.
Before: a USB stick is plugged in (tray), but nothing for it on the desktop.
After: plugging the stick in adds its icon; double-clicking it mounts it and opens it in Dolphin.
